newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Heilongjiang 1996 grain output seen up.
newsitem.headline: China's Heilongjiang 1996 grain output seen up.

text.p: Grain output in China's northeastern province of Heilongjiang is expected to rise 17.4 percent to 30.465 million tonnes in 1996 compared with 1995, a provincial agricultural official said on Tuesday.
Corn output was estimated at 14.45 million tonnes in 1996, up 18.5 percent from 1995, while rice output was expected to jump 34.9 percent to 6.36 million tonnes, the official told Reuters.
Soybean output was expected to total 4.135 million tonnes in 1996, down slightly compared with last year, because of shrinking land under soybean, he said.
Wheat output was seen at 3.3 million tonnes this year, higher than last year, the official said. He declined to give further details of other crops.
Heilongjiang is one of China's main grain producing provinces.
